claims.statement: The official BDO system provides API-key functionality intended to integrate a reporting entity's account with external systems.
The 2025 product, packaging and waste report was due electronically in BDO by 15 March 2026, showing a recurring filing event rather than a one-off transition.
Joining sales data to a verified packaging bill of materials will reduce manual reporting work and corrections for small importers.

contrary_evidence: Invoices generally do not contain packaging mass, so automation still depends on initial supplier and SKU data work.
BDO provides free instructions and training, while compliance consultants already prepare filings.
Polish packaging and EPR rules are evolving, which could change fields and buyer workflows.

economics.acquisition_route: Partner with boutique BDO advisers and accounting offices that already hold the customer relationship; acquire the first pilot from a Warsaw importer or ecommerce operator with a manageable catalog.
economics.founder_time: Part-time validation hypothesis; delivery burden remains untested.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Reusable supplier and packaging-component mappings can reduce work across a customer's catalog and, with explicit rights, across common suppliers. The value comes from verified mappings and workflow integration, not an assumed data moat.
fingerprint.customer: Polish ecommerce sellers, importers and small brands that place packaged goods on the market and must aggregate packaging or product data for BDO reporting.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Partner with boutique BDO advisers and accounting offices that already hold the customer relationship; acquire the first pilot from a Warsaw importer or ecommerce operator with a manageable catalog.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Map each SKU and bundle to packaging materials and weights, ingest order or KSeF exports, flag missing or implausible mappings, produce an audit trail, and push or export approved values for BDO. A named human remains responsible for filings.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The business or its environmental-compliance adviser pays an onboarding fee to build a packaging bill of materials and a recurring fee for monthly reconciliation and a year-end BDO-ready export.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Monthly or annual reporting approaches and the company has sales and purchasing data but packaging weights live in supplier files, spreadsheets and SKU notes that do not reconcile cleanly.

founder_fit: Data cleaning and reconciliation are core founder strengths
Monthly asynchronous processing is compatible with a full-time job
A narrow catalog pilot requires little capital
Advisor channels can reduce high-energy direct sales
risks: Evidence of a workflow, transition, or loss does not yet establish recurring willingness to pay.
The proposed distribution and compounding mechanisms remain hypotheses pending buyer evidence.

title: SKU-to-BDO packaging mass reconciliation for importers and ecommerce
uncertainties: How many target SMEs have enough SKUs or volume to justify software
Whether third-party advisers can use BDO API access on a client's behalf
Quality and stability of packaging weight data from suppliers
Error rates, correction costs and willingness to pay
Pricing, buyer authority, and acquisition economics remain unvalidated at discovery.

First validation test: For one consenting importer with 100 to 500 active SKUs, reconstruct the prior reporting year from order exports and a manually verified packaging table, compare totals with the filed report, and price a monthly continuation. Proceed only if reconciliation finds material gaps or saves enough documented hours for the buyer to sign a paid renewal.
